claim: Patchline represents migration-failure analysis as a causal graph rather than a flat list of correlates, computing the set of nodes that are genuine causal ancestors of the failure outcome so that root causes are separated from quantities that merely co-occur with failure, and it verifies the graph is acyclic before drawing any causal conclusion. The worker validates that the graph is a DAG, computes the transitive ancestors of the failure node as the root-cause set, and confirms that a node which is only correlated — present in the graph but with no directed path to the failure — is excluded from that set. The gate proves the true root causes are identified, the spurious correlate is excluded, and a cyclic graph is rejected.
